title: 2026.45: Falling Leaves (and Stocks)
author: Ben Thompson
description: The best Stratechery content from the week of November 2, 2026, including AI on the ballot, a Google state of the union, and China.
summary: (Photo by Jon Cherry/Getty Images) Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery! As a reminder, each week, every Friday, we’re sending out this overview of content in the Stratechery bundle; highlighted links are free for everyone .
takeaways: Looking at their actual performance, we can see that while SaaS stocks were selling off, revenue growth was actually accelerating.
Last week Google reported earnings and saw growth in search revenue slow for the first time in five quarters.
Given the appearance of mortality in what might be the greatest business in the history of digital commerce, investors were predictably spooked.
